books.title: Colesium Vol I
pages:
Forced to do battle with endless opponents, 
Kain was a fighter for the Empire, 
currently the champion, a meaningless title
 for it isn't long before a competitor 
overcomes you and your name once 
thought to be eternally within the minds 
of the people, is now forgotten, as your 
lifeless carcass is thrown into 
the "Inferno", a pit which burns of sulfur 
eternally deep within the Coliseums 
main structure located at the core of 
a complex maze, to advanced for a single h
uman mind to navigate. 

Kain walked silently into the arena, the 
stands absolutely saturated with observers 
for the day. 
"Kain has met his match!" as told by the 
countless bulletins and posters designed 
to draw in the blood thirsty audience 
gathered here today to see death.  

The crank of the rusty gate being opened 
was the only sound to interrupt the 
deafening silence.  This gate was the 
only defense against the dreaded "
Monster's Den", an ancient cavern where 
countless species of monsters thrived.  

Monsters previously undiscovered, would 
roam out of the blackness to feast upon the 
fighters, who would wield a weapon 
foolishly in an attempt to gain fame, 
fortune, or some other prize they felt was 
worth the risk of their lives, for gain. 
Out of the darkness came a 
blood-chilling roar of absolute horrible 
content.  This was the call of the most 
dreaded of flesh- ripping, bone-shattering 
beasts, the "Behemoth".  First, it's mighty 
paw appeared from the darkness depths, 
still stained with the dripping blood of 
it's last pitiful victim.  Claws the size of 
a man, which in a single slash, could tear 
a man apart.  Then the tip of it's face with 
rabid teeth and flaring nostrils.  

The face once hidden in the hellish caverns,
 was brought into the light of this gloomy 
day, a spiked collar was tightly strapped 
around the jugular of this beast, as if it 
were a pet.  No doubt a symbol of one 
warriors' shining moment. 
 
 
As the fearful sight stepped into the arena,
 it  roared once more toward the heavens 
and then began to struggle, fighting the 
incredibly heavy chains attached to the 
mammoth collar.  The soldier of the 
Empire moved in with weapon's 
thrusting, hacking, stabbing the beast, 
attempting to break it's will to escape 
back into it's home... 

Kain was a soldier of the Empire,  like 
the military which protects our region, 
but though loyal, and honorable through 
and through, was picked at random to 
compete in the coliseum only to entertain 
the Emperor's lust for war.  But that is 
forgotten.  This handsome soldier is now
 scarred and bruised in every fashion, 
mentally, physically and spiritually.  
His face  shaded by bruises and welts, 
his hands covered by open wounds and 
his soul tiring of this endless routine.  

The beast was covered in a skin of blood, 
a reminder of it's recent rebellion toward
 the Empire, now stood dazed and in a 
state of confusion.  Unaware, the beast 
lowered it's enormous head to it's 
supposed victim, Kain.  Kain stood 
undaunted by the fearsome beast, 
still disoriented from the vicious attack 
which was punishment for it's free spirit.  

As the beast examined it's foe with the 
single useful eye, (due to the other 
being sewed shut and covered in scar t
issue), it hissed and snorted.  
A golden ring went through it's nostrils 
like a bull, which created a blinding glare 
from the sun which peeked out from 
behind the thick sheets of clouds. 
As all these thoughts rushed through 
Kain's head, still filled with the image 
of the horrid monster present, the 
monster attacked.  An enormous paw 
passed over the head of Kain, tearing the 
air as it thundered past.  Kain leaped 
from his position and flew at the beast 
with lightening speed.  He swung the 
ax and defended the attacks of the 
monstrous beast simultaneously, striking 
several flesh wounds.  Behemoth became 
angered and annoyed by the slight warrior
causing him these minor pains.  
Behemoth roared with a deafening hatred, 
 echoing and shifting the coliseum, 
harming the audience and Kain, like all, 
collapsed into a state of pain clasping his
 ears it hide from the evil calls.  

Kain leaped to his feet and in a blind rage
 charged toward the beast dropping his 
shield and wielding his ax in both hands. 
 The enormous head dove toward Kain,
 missing him.  A fatal mistake.  The ax 
connected with the thick armor protecting
 the vital organs of the monster, and it 
ran a clean cut along the chest.  
The surprised beast lowered himself, 
and his organs dropped down, slightly
 exposing themselves.  Blood  raining 
from the wound slipped over upon the 
ground creating a puddle for the beast
 to collapse in.  It did- 
Kain was enraged and mad with hatred 
for the beast and the Empire and his 
slavery.
 
The soldiers at the gate were no 
longer there.  The gate was closed, 
but the mesh of iron forming the gate 
introduced holes large enough for Kain 
to enter through.  Some holes were 
large enough for an elephant to roam into, 
showing the size of the beasts which 
were trapped behind those bars.  

Kain rushed toward the gate as soldiers
 came closer to collect him and lock him
 away once more.  Kain dashed to the
 gate, racing past several desperate 
soldiers intent on his capture.  
Kain dashed to the gate, racing past 
several desperate soldiers intent on his 
capture.  He easily gained access to the 
den, though no soldier followed paralyzed
in fear.  Kain continued to run swearing 
to himself if he was ever to look upon 
another soldier of the Empire that day, 
blood would be spilled. 


















                 Ashka Valse, Historian, 8 CE

books.title: Dragon Almanac
pages:
Dragons are one of nature’s most rare and 
magnificent creations. Often called the lost 
link between the dinosaurs and birds. 
However, dragons evolutionary lineage 
is a mystery even today. 

Dragons belong to the distinct Draconis
 family, in the reptile kingdom. 

There are 127 recorded species of dragon. 
Each quite distinctive from each other, 
though always retaining several key 
properties. Including, a set of retractable
 wings, a long jointed neck, talons, 
horns, a crested head and a powerful 
crushing jaw.

Dragons hatch from eggs ranging from 
2 1/2 to 4 feet in diameter, which hatch 
between 6 months and 1 year after being
 laid. New born dragons, have the ability 
to fend for themselves right out of the egg.

 However, flight will not be possible until
 at least the 3rd molting, which occurs 
around the ages of 15-30. Most dragons 
will experience between 6 to 12 moltings
 within there lifetimes, occurring around 
every dozen years or so. Becoming less 
frequent as the dragon grows older. 

The average lifespan of a dragon is 
between 150-300 years dependant upon
species.

Two of the most frequently asked questions 
about dragons are these: How does a
 dragon fly? and of course, How does a 
dragon breath fire? I will answer both 
questions.

Firstly, how does a dragon fly? 
Even hatchlings weigh around a ton. 
However keep in mind, that dragon’s 
bones are hollow much like a birds, and 
there bodies are incredibly aerodynamic, 
not to mention there incredible strength 
applied to there wings, spanning between 
15 and 40 ft. All this contributes to it’s
ability to fly.

Dragons are capable of vertical takeoff, 
and intricate aerial maneuvers.

There flapping wings can create winds of 
up to 60 miles per hour, depending upon 
there size.

Usefulness of wings depend solely on 
the species, Woodland Green 
Dragons (Draconis Emeralis) can glide for 
short 15 second bounds covering a 
maximum of around 200 yards, while
the Northern Frost Dragon 
(Draconis Frosticus) can glide on artic
currents for up to 15 hours without 
landing, and easily cover a hunting 
ground of more than 100 miles wide.

Perhaps more fascinating is many species 
of dragons completely unique ability to 
breath fire.

While apparently magical at first glance,
this can be explained with a relatively 
simple chemical explanation. 

Every dragon capable of breathing fire has 
a set of gill like slits known as drakes on 
it’s throat below it’s larynx, dragons 
suck in air through these drakes, which 
is used to fuel the fire, generated from 
within them. The drakes are the most 
vulnerable part of a dragons body, on 
the Granite Dragon (Draconis Petricus), 
it is the only part of its body that is 
penetrable by a steel blade.

A dragon’s saliva is a flammable substance 
and contains several key trace elements
including sulpher, hydrogen, and 
prosperous.

To create flame, dragons excrete a thick 
fluid from glands within its mouth, 
which is air flammable. This ignites the 
saliva, thanks to the air taken in by the 
drakes. Merely directing it’s airflow a 
dragon, depending upon species can fire 
a sustained stream of flame over 20 feet, 
and around 2000 degrees farienhight.

Dragons are also renowned for there 
healing properties. There are several 
well documented cases of Dragon’s 
blood being used to cure blindness, 
arthritis, and even leprosy.

Ground dragon scale powder is often 
smoked to alleviate chronic pains, and 
severe migraines. Dragon’s heart is 
considered the most prestigious delicacy 
in areas such as Xanadu, Shangri-La, 
and several outer Atlantean colonies. 

Other parts of a dragon, teeth, horns, 
bones, and talons are all parts of many 
other shamanistic remedies for ailments. 
Dragons teeth are said, if planted 
beneath a tree, to have it bearing fruit 
within it’s first year. Dragon tongues 
can even be made into flame retardant 
hoods.

Some of the more unique species of dragon
are the Forest Spitting dragon 
(Draconis Projectius), whose salvia is 
highly flesh corrosive, the Leviathan 
Dragon (Draconis Majorus Aquaticus), 
a sea dwelling species, which has a long 
serpentine body that can encircle and 
crush a wooden ships hull, and most 
fearsome of all the Black Dragon 
(Draconis Omega) also called the 
volcano dragon, this 150 foot beast, 
has a jet black shell like skin, and 
several dozen horn outcroppings.

Only four attacks by a black dragon have 
been recorded in history, each resulting in 
udder incineration of the attack site. 

This is measly when compared to the 
record of the extremely aggressive and 
common place Red Dragon 
(Draconis Crimson) this species at it’s 
aggressive height, before steps were 
taken to control their population were 
the cause of nearly 200 attacks yearly, 
around the world.

Not all dragons are violent predators 
however. The Queteszulquel 
(Draconis Feathris) for instance, is quite 
friendly and docile, The quetezulquel’s 
body is covered in feathers of white

and pastels. It eats primarily small prey no 
larger than a cat and has successfully been 
domesticated.

Dragons are quite diverse, though 
unfortunately not very plentiful. The 
sudden decrease in the dragon population 
globally can not be explained. Though it 
almost certainly has something to do 
with man’s interference. Dragons are by
 far one of the most prized creations in 
existence beautiful and terrifying, as
 well as awe inspiring. There legend
 inspires us and fills our hearts with
 excitement.

They represent power, order, riotousness, 
and honor. They deserve our respect and 
protection.

Pass the knowledge on . . .
Dros Bros. Printing, 31 CE

books.title: Grimoire de'Alchemiste
pages:
Alchemy is the fusing of science with 
magic, accepted truth with lore, and 
order with choas. 

Born out of mans desire to find the 
true nature of things, physical or 
otherwise. 

Modern alchemists work under the 
knowledge, that the universe is ever 
evolving, and given enough time all 
things would eventually develop into 
there own perfect state of being 
known as Ascension. 

Acension is highest form of exsistence 
attainable by any organism.

However, over time the Great Work was 
warped by mankinds greed for the 
precious minerals, and the pursuit 
of everlasting, though an ultimataly 
empty physical life.

As centuries progressed and alchemy 
became a twisted perversion of its 
original intent, those loyal to the 
anchient Order of Hermes, whose members 
dedicated there lives to the further 
exploration of the composition of life, 
disappeared from public scructeny and 
continued there nobel work in the shadows 
of society, sharing there findings only 
within the loose network of alchemical 
guilds known as Chantries

There no longer exsists formal acedemies 
of alchemy, all have been brought down 
in flames by heathens and witch hunters 
who though centuries of ignorant 
prosicution of those who seek the truth 
have brought about the near extinction 
of alchemy. 

Alchemiess secrets were preserved 
however, passed on through remaining 
cryptic tomes and generation after 
generation of diligent apprenticship.

Years of apprenticeship are required in 
order to properly pass on the knowledge. 

During this period the apprentice more 
closely resembles an indentured servant.

Slowly the apprentice learns the art from 
scraps of information, the rantings of the 
master and his own intuition. 

Some alchemists claim that the hard 
apprenticeship is necessary to impart the 
practical knowledge and the burning desire 
to succeed as a true alchemist. 

Without suffering; reward is meaningless.
                               - Tristan's 3rd Law

To Anna,
             My best student and lover
                                       -M

books.title: Poetry Book
pages:
-----------------------------------------------------------
TABLE OF CONTENTS
-----------------------------------------------------------

Awakening                                  pg III

One Way Thought                        pg V

Why?                                         pg VII

Shifted Perspectives                    pg X

People                                       pg XI

Along the coast of castaways       pg XII
-----------------------------------------------------------
'Awakening' or 'A Chance'
-----------------------------------------------------------

I awoke one morning to a cruel world.
To the sounds of tears and sadness; and 
that impending loneliness.
On my knees I found my lowest point.

As the tears ran down and away, distinct 
trails of red, 
I looked up and the sky was cold slate.
I saw disappointment in a reflection.

It spoke to me, led me down the path and 
without warning left me to the wolves.
I awoke one morning to a just world.
To the songs of hope and laughter; to those 
eyes and that unforgettable face.
I ascended in my mind's eye and had to 
shield my eyes from the light.

As the tears ran down and away, toward 
the sun,I looked around and all was well.
I saw approval in a reflection.

It spoke to me, presented me with my 
weapon, and left me to the wolves. 


-----------------------------------------------------------
One Way Thought
-----------------------------------------------------------

To all the ones we called a friend,
the same that left us in the end.
We pity them, and we pity ourselves;
They live with their choice, and we
 without.

Those seeming truths only in our heads,
The reality sets in once the damage is said.
Hindsight seen with an eagle's eye;
Foresight like a swarm of flies.

We often see the faults in all but ourselves.
Never blessed to look around.
Painful lessons learned with double sides,
The sores a person tries to hide.
Moralities bent to suit ones needs.
Judgment placed on all we see.
With bitterness in the hearts of all,
We note each and everyone elses flaws.

The words we needed come minutes late.
The points we make; they never take.
Minds are not changed by an outside view,
The truth of self: seen is by few.
-----------------------------------------------------------
Why?
-----------------------------------------------------------

Why do we suffer when others wrong us?
They do not contemplate the burden of 
their touch.

Winding away in hours of woe meant for 
another.
So easy to see our faults, through others.

Justice? Divine scales measuring their 
worth? Mayhap some day
Their guilt, like dead weight; 
They descend, in turn we elevate
Expression is realease, to create is divine.
and dreams become sanctuary from the 
trivialities of light.

Masks, our favorite accessories, ones we 
never loose.
The same which makes you liked by a 
multitude of groups.
We put them on, and take them off to 
change who we will be.
But when we're alone, and the masks are 
gone you'll find what you hope others see.

In a world of infinite color and form,
in a place that is cool when it's too warm,
in a home where life is it's own reward,
it will all be as it should have been all 
along.
We cry if we must, and scream when we 
wish.
Curse the heavens, damn the stars, then we
repent for our sins.
But some care not, and want only to do 
hate.
Others care too much and are pained by 
what others create.

They want to help, but too feeble are 
minds.
No entrance past the surface, and no 
deeper in time.
The only questions to ask are: 

"What if?", 
"What was?", 
"What will be?", 
and "Why?"
-----------------------------------------------------------
Shifted Perspectives
-----------------------------------------------------------

A vision of heaven, a glimpse of the devil
I have seen these things around me

Born curious and open to experience
Their worth I can not say
Many good, some bad, a few just strange

To see the world in a different light;
a heavenly blessing indeed
Perspective shifting, objections lifting the world is not so gray

Becoming duller still as it slopes down hill
and time becomes the enemy
I can see the truth in a world of lies
but reality's meaning escapes me
-----------------------------------------------------------
People
-----------------------------------------------------------

The most charismatic are often the most 
rehearsed

The quietest people hold the most worth i
n their words

The sad ones have the most to give
but fail to see a light within

Devil may care, without moral guides
a deadly rollar coaster ride

Vanity clouds a person's mind
behind a mask of pity, they hide
Short on life, with an abundance of time
Just another drone of the hive
-----------------------------------------------------------
Along the Coast of Castaways
-----------------------------------------------------------

I awoke upon the shores of a violet sea.
How I'd come to nap in such a place I 
cannot say.
Lilac waves wash over bare feet.
As I lay on the white sands of a tide 
washed beach.

Ivory stones polished by age.
Along the coast of waking castaways.
Flat and smooth they ricochet,
Across the amethyst surface of the lake. 

The brilliant sun shone too bright to place.
I lick my lips; a salty taste
My body parched by the lazy heat,
from a sun too bright to see.
White birds diving for silver flunes.
Their toneless song of broken notes,
Disturbs the peace of the lavender bay.
The only sound, save the crashing waves.
 
I hear a siren's song faintly on the wind.
With every note, you are born again.
As sweet as honey, but the melody thins.
Replaced by a wailing banshee's scream.

Cloudless sky becomes smoldering slate.
White birds scatter, the flunes are saved.
Lightning flashes, as the very air quakes.
A storm has come to claim the day.

A violet sea enraged by the squall
It stirs with rage as its replenisher falls
The calm plum crests become grapy beasts
That swallow the shoreline of the white 
sand beach
Across the channel of coral reefs,
Upon the beach; a planted seed.
A fruit tree grew; I hid beneath.
Shielded from icy drops of frozen hate.

A bolt from heaven strikes the tree
Ignites green flames of emerald heat
Consumes my shelter; from across the breach
the scent of fruit is bitter sweet.














         To Ariel, 
         We love you very, very much!
          Happy Birthday! 

          Aunt Leane and Uncle Steward
